fields.label: Skill Name
fields.description: Short slug: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3-40 chars). Shown to the user without the internal 'custom-' prefix.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: When off, the skill is kept as a draft and NOT pushed to the assistant on Apply.

fields.label: User Invocable
fields.description: When on, the skill can be triggered explicitly from the chat composer with a '/' command.

fields.label: Allow Approve & run
fields.description: ADMIN ONLY. When on, a declared 2+-step plan run of this skill offers 'Approve & run': one approval opens an uncarded run of the explicit _SKILL_AUTORUN_COVERED allowlist (create_doc/create_docs/update_doc/submit_doc/run_import/apply_workflow_action/send_email/share_doc/assign_to/update_wiki/run_method) until the run ends; the destructive trio (delete/cancel/amend) and create_custom_skill always still park. Enabling requires the Jarvis Admin / System Manager role; disabling is free for the owner - the toggle IS the kill switch (un-arm = instant off, no deploy).

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Scope ladder (security review PART 2 TASK 10, mirrors Jarvis Wiki Page). User = private to the owner (default; reached via jarvis__find_skills / jarvis__get_skill, never pushed to the shared catalog). Role = holders of Target Role. Org = everyone; joins the shared assistant catalog on Apply. Widening (User->Role->Org) is reviewer-approved only. Empty (pre-migration rows) means Org.

fields.label: Target Role
fields.description: Required for Role-scope skills: the single role whose holders may see/invoke this skill (the Wiki-parallel audience field).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: One-line summary of when to use this skill (becomes the SKILL.md frontmatter description).

fields.label: Instructions (Markdown)
fields.description: Markdown body of the SKILL.md: what the assistant should do when this skill is used.

fields.label: Shared With
fields.description: Users this skill is shared with (read-only for them; only the owner can edit or re-share).

fields.label: Allowed Roles
fields.description: Empty = visible to everyone. Otherwise only the owner, shared-with users and holders of one of these roles (System Manager always passes) see/invoke the skill.

fields.label: Managed by Learning
fields.description: Marker only: this row is a consolidated learned-<domain> skill compiled from approved learned patterns; the learning board is its management surface.

fields.label: Roles Derived
fields.description: Provenance for allowed_roles on a compiler-managed row (issue #479): 1 means the role derivation ran to a conclusion for every source doctype, so an EMPTY allowed_roles genuinely means no desk role narrows this skill. 0 means the derivation could not be completed and the empty set is a fallback, not a finding. Recorded only - no code reads it, and an empty allowed_roles still means everyone.

fields.label: Source Skill
fields.description: Lineage marker (R2-SP-3): for a system-owned shared copy materialized by a reviewer-approved promotion, the docname of the requester's private source skill it was promoted FROM. A later higher-scope approval of the SAME source supersedes this copy in place (User->Role then User->Org yields one shared copy at Org, no orphan). Plain Data (not a Link) so deleting the private source never blocks on it.
